comment: Single source of truth for the 11 original muse-rsi skills (v3.0 G1, M-13). setup/setup.py and scripts/generate_registry.py both read this file; do not duplicate the list anywhere else. Fields: name (skill dir), title (registry notes), category (install-time category), domain (router domain), description_override (null = use the skill's own frontmatter description).

originals.description_override: Screenshot any page or HTML file at 360, 768, and 1280 pixels plus dark mode, and report console errors, failed requests, and horizontal overflow — so design work is judged by looking at it, not by reading code.
originals.name: visual-check
originals.title: Visual Check
